dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.greetingSubtitle: Find an opportunity that moves your career forward.

readinessSteps.profile: Add your name and contact details
readinessSteps.professional: Add your headline, summary and skills

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: This information is shared with universities and organizations when relevant.
profile.createHint: You don't have a profile yet — fill in the details below to create one.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.enrollmentHint: Your university verifies these records, so they are managed on the enrollment page.

enrollment.title: University enrollment
enrollment.pendingReviewBody: Your university is reviewing your enrollment. You'll be notified when the review is complete or if more evidence is needed.
enrollment.challengeBody: Generate a one-time code and show it to university staff when they verify you in person.
enrollment.claimSubtitle: Tell us which university and department you're enrolled in.

errors.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ALREADY_EXISTS: You already have an enrollment on file.
errors.STUDENT_NUMBER_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This student number is already registered at this university.
errors.DEPARTMENT_NOT_IN_UNIVERSITY: This department does not belong to the selected university.
errors.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_LOCKED: This enrollment cannot be edited while a verification case is active.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_ALREADY_RESOLVED: This verification case has already been resolved.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_INVALID_TRANSITION: A verification case is already in progress.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the details and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't save that right now. Check your connection and try again.
errors.STUDENT_ID_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Upload a valid Student ID before submitting for verification.

verified.title: Your university has verified your enrollment
verified.body: You can now apply to internships and be nominated by your department. This confirms your enrollment only — it is separate from your account and from institution verification.
verified.nextBody: Applications are open to you. A complete profile is what organizations read first.

enrollment.studentNumberHint: The student number your university issued you. University staff check it against their records.
enrollment.whyBody: Only students confirmed by their own university can apply to internships or be nominated. Your university’s staff check these details against their records.

statusMeaning.DRAFT: Your details are saved but not yet sent to your university. Upload your student ID, then submit.
statusMeaning.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: Your university needs more evidence before it can decide. Read the note below, upload a clearer or different document, then resubmit.
statusMeaning.REJECTED: Your university could not confirm this enrollment. Contact your university’s internship office if you think this is a mistake.
statusMeaning.REVOKED: Your university has withdrawn this verification. Contact your university’s internship office to resolve it.

enrollment.whileWaiting: While you wait, you can complete your profile and browse internships. Applying opens once your enrollment is verified.

cv.title: Your CV
cv.description: PDF only, up to 5 MB. Only you and recruiters at organizations where you have applied or been nominated can open it.

errors.generic: Your CV could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.CV_FILE_INVALID: That file was not accepted. Upload a PDF.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large. The maximum size is 5 MB.
errors.CV_NOT_FOUND: No CV has been uploaded yet.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_REQUIRED: Upload a PDF CV for this application.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_NOT_FOUND: This CV is unavailable for this application. Upload it again.
errors.APPLICATION_CV_ALREADY_USED: This CV is already attached to a submitted application.
errors.STUDENT_ACTION_REQUIRED: Applications and saved internships are available to Student accounts.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: This document is no longer available. Upload it again.

evidence.title: Verification evidence
evidence.description: A PDF or photo of your student card or enrollment letter, up to 10 MB. Only you, your university's reviewers and FursadHub verification staff can open it.

errors.generic: Your evidence could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.EVIDENCE_FILE_INVALID: That file was not accepted. Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large. The maximum size is 10 MB.
errors.VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING: No evidence has been uploaded yet.
errors.VERIFICATION_CASE_NOT_FOUND: Submit your enrollment for verification first.
errors.STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_LOCKED: Evidence can be changed before submission or when your reviewer requests more evidence.
errors.ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND: Save your enrollment details before uploading Student ID.

saved.title: Saved internships
saved.subtitle: Internships you bookmarked while browsing. Only internships that are still open to applications appear here.
saved.empty: You have not saved any internships yet
saved.emptyHint: Use the bookmark on any internship to keep it here for later.
saved.error: We could not load your saved internships.
saved.emptyNeedsProfile: Saving an internship needs your student profile. Add your details once and your bookmarks will be kept here.

placementActive.title: Your internship is active
placementActive.body: Keep your logs, attendance and report up to date — everything for this internship is in one place.

placementPlanned.title: Your internship is confirmed
placementPlanned.body: It starts on {{date}}. Your host organization starts it in FursadHub on your first day.

completionPending.title: Your internship is being reviewed for completion
completionPending.body: Your university is checking the completion requirements. You will be notified when it is complete.

offerWaiting.title: You have an internship offer waiting
offerWaiting.body: Review the offer and respond before {{date}}. Only you can accept or decline it.

nominationWaiting.title: Your university nominated you
nominationWaiting.body: The organization sees your nomination only after you agree to be considered.

enrollmentMissing.title: Start by claiming your university enrollment
enrollmentMissing.body: Your university confirms you are their student. Until then you can browse, but not apply or be nominated.

enrollmentIncomplete.title: Finish your enrollment
enrollmentIncomplete.body: Add your student ID and submit it so your university can confirm your enrollment.

enrollmentChangesRequested.title: Your university asked for more evidence
enrollmentChangesRequested.body: Read their note, update your student ID, and submit again.

enrollmentInReview.title: Your university is reviewing your enrollment
enrollmentInReview.body: There is nothing you need to do right now. You can browse internships while you wait; applying opens once you are verified.

enrollmentClosed.title: Your enrollment is not verified
enrollmentClosed.body: Your university did not confirm your enrollment. Read their note on the enrollment page.

applicationsInProgress.title: Your applications are in progress
applicationsInProgress.body: Organizations are reviewing them. You will be notified when something changes.

completed.title: You completed your internship
completed.body: Congratulations. Your internship record stays available here.

readyToApply.title: You're ready to apply
readyToApply.body: Your enrollment is verified. Find an internship that fits you and apply.

attention.title: Needs your attention
attention.clearBody: You're up to date. New requests from your university or organizations will appear here.

nomination.title: Agree to be considered for {{title}}
nomination.titleNoOpportunity: Agree to be considered for a nomination

missing.title: Claim your university enrollment
missing.meta: Needed to apply or be nominated

incomplete.title: Submit your enrollment for verification
incomplete.meta: Add your student ID, then submit

changesRequested.title: Your university asked for more evidence
changesRequested.meta: Update your student ID and submit again

weeklyLogReturned.title: Week {{week}} log was returned for changes
weeklyLogReturned.meta: Read your supervisor's comment and resubmit

attendanceToConfirm.meta: Confirm or dispute what your organization recorded

finalReportRevision.title: Your final report needs revision
finalReportRevision.meta: Read the reviewer's comment, update and resubmit

lifecycle.title: Your internship journey
lifecycle.label: Internship progress
lifecycle.noRequirements: Your university requires nothing beyond the internship itself.
lifecycle.unavailable: Requirements could not be loaded. Open the internship to see them.

recruitment.title: Applications and nominations
recruitment.emptyHint: Applications you submit, and nominations from your university, will appear here.
